The pandas route passes, but the LIAC backend exposed another masked dependency: its bundled decoder’s `load` entry point and decode methods are missing, so every LIAC integration currently stops before dispatch behavior can be validated. I’m restoring that bundled parser surface from the surviving tokenizer/data classes and then rerunning the focused suite.
